kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يمت (form I)
# يَمُتُّ (yamuttu) /ja.mut.tu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of مَتَّ (matta)
# يُمَتُّ (yumattu) /ju.mat.tu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of مَتَّ (matta)
# يَمُتَّ (yamutta) /ja.mut.ta/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of مَتَّ (matta)
# يُمَتَّ (yumatta) /ju.mat.ta/: third-person masc
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
